# `auth.totp.disable`

Disable the second factor

Session with fresh auth. Clears the secret and burns recovery codes.

- Method and path: `POST /settings/security/totp/disable`
- Scope: `repo:read`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie auth totp disable`
- MCP: `auth_totp_disable`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string` |

## Errors

`unauthorized`, plus the framework problems.
